verdict.rationale: Mesh documents that a customer can be a company and that customers are screened against sanctions, watchlists, PEP and adverse-media data, so screening business entities is supported. Nothing in the evidence shows linked ownership, beneficial-owner, or association risk context that an analyst could inspect. Missing for 10: documented ownership/UBO or related-party linkage, inspection of association-driven risk for entities, and independent or hands-on corroboration of company screening.
